name: stoopside.groups.list
description: List every group (discovery) with your membership state and role. Optional substring query on name and description.

name: stoopside.groups.get
description: One group: privacy flags, your membership, its organizers and hosts, and (for members) upcoming events.

name: stoopside.groups.join
description: Join a group. Groups that require approval record a pending request (approval_pending if one is already waiting).

name: stoopside.groups.leave
description: Leave a group or withdraw a pending request. Leaving sets your upcoming RSVPs in the group to no and releases your sign-up slots (sole_organizer, sole_host).

name: stoopside.members.search
description: Search a group's members by part of a display name or bio. Shows member ID, display name, bio and role, never emails. Groups with hide_from_member_list allow this only to organizers and co-organizers.

name: stoopside.members.export
description: Co-organizers and organizers: every member of a group with email address and member-since date (role_required otherwise).

name: stoopside.profile.get
description: Your own profile and memberships.

name: stoopside.profile.update
description: Change your display name or bio.

name: stoopside.events.list
description: Events in your groups, soonest first, with places taken and free, waitlist size and your RSVP. Past events only with include_past.

name: stoopside.events.get
description: One event with your RSVP, its change history, sign-up sheets and (unless hide_rsvps hides it from you) the guest list.

name: stoopside.events.preview_change
description: Preview creating (change=create, group_id, fields), editing (change=edit, event_id, fields, notify) or cancelling (change=cancel, event_id) an event. Lists who will be notified and which RSVPs must reconfirm. Changing date, time or venue needs notify: guests or group. Expires after 15 minutes.

name: stoopside.events.confirm_change
description: Confirm an event preview. Fails preview_expired after 15 minutes and preview_stale if anything it read has changed.

name: stoopside.rsvps.preview
description: Preview an RSVP (answer yes or no) with guest and child counts. Counts you leave out are pre-filled from your latest RSVP in that group; the preview shows which RSVP and when. Shows whether you get a place or go on the waitlist. Also claims an offered place or reconfirms a held one. Expires after 15 minutes.

name: stoopside.rsvps.confirm
description: Confirm an RSVP preview and get a receipt (also sent to your Mail).

name: stoopside.posts.list
description: Posts, comments and announcements in a group that you can see now, oldest first. Optional event_id filter.

name: stoopside.posts.preview
description: Preview a post, comment, announcement or edit. Posts and announcements need an audience (group, event_guests with event_id, or hosts_only); comments take parent_id and use its audience; edit_of edits your own post's text. Lists every member who will be notified. Expires after 15 minutes.

name: stoopside.posts.publish
description: Publish a post preview. Publishing notifies the listed members; nothing delivered can be recalled.

name: stoopside.posts.delete
description: Delete a post (author, co-organizers and organizers). Hides it from now on; recalls nothing already delivered. Announcements and posts on past or cancelled events are locked.

name: stoopside.signups.get
description: A sign-up sheet: slots, who holds them, your claims, lock time and swaps involving you.

name: stoopside.signups.claim
description: Claim one unit of a slot before the sheet locks (slot_taken, sheet_locked).

name: stoopside.signups.release
description: Release your claim on a slot before the sheet locks (not_your_slot, swap_pending).

name: stoopside.signups.swap_propose
description: Offer your claim on give_slot for another member's claim on want_slot. They must accept; it expires after 48 hours or at the lock.

name: stoopside.signups.swap_answer
description: Accept or decline a swap offered to you, or withdraw one you proposed. Accepting exchanges the two claims.

name: stoopside.visibility.view_as
description: Show a group, event, post or sheet as a named member can see it now. Not what was already delivered to them. Objects you cannot see are not_found.

name: stoopside.help.get
description: Stoopside's rules: time and deadlines, groups, events and RSVPs, posts, sign-up sheets and visibility.
